form.label: Imperva WAF - Block Malicious IP IOCs
form.description: Per IP: click "⛔ Block" in the table, then "✅ CONFIRM BLOCK". Not block: click "✖ Not block". Manual block / unblock: click any other cell (or type IPs), choose action, tick "I confirm", press Submit.

panel.title: IPs detected by WAF attack rules (ES notables / incidents, $ioc_range_label$) + VirusTotal - click "⛔ Block" to block that IP

search.query: `imperva_ioc_notables` | eval _finding_guid=lower(coalesce(source_guid, mvindex(split(source_event_id, "@@"), 0))) | join type=left max=1 _finding_guid [| impervanotes | rename finding_guid AS _finding_guid | fields _finding_guid ithm] | eval _tm_ip=if(match(lower(coalesce(threat_match_field, "")), "ip|src|dest|addr"), threat_match_value, null()) | eval ioc_ip=mvdedup(mvappend(_tm_ip, coalesce(src, src_ip))) | mvexpand ioc_ip | where isnotnull(ioc_ip) AND match(ioc_ip, "^[0-9A-Fa-f:.]+$") AND (match(ioc_ip, "^\d{1,3}(\.\d{1,3}){3}$") OR match(ioc_ip, ":")) | where NOT (cidrmatch("10.0.0.0/8", ioc_ip) OR cidrmatch("172.16.0.0/12", ioc_ip) OR cidrmatch("192.168.0.0/16", ioc_ip) OR cidrmatch("127.0.0.0/8", ioc_ip) OR cidrmatch("169.254.0.0/16", ioc_ip) OR cidrmatch("100.64.0.0/10", ioc_ip) OR cidrmatch("0.0.0.0/8", ioc_ip) OR cidrmatch("224.0.0.0/3", ioc_ip)) | `imperva_ioc_fields` | eval _sev_rank=case(lower(ioc_severity)="critical",5, lower(ioc_severity)="high",4, lower(ioc_severity)="medium",3, lower(ioc_severity)="low",2, in(lower(ioc_severity), "informational", "info"),1, true(),0) | stats count AS notable_count values(ioc_rule) AS rule_name values(ioc_incident) AS incident_no max(_sev_rank) AS _sev_rank values(status_label) AS status values(threat_collection) AS threat_collection values(dest) AS dest min(_time) AS first_seen max(_time) AS last_seen BY ioc_ip | rename ioc_ip AS src | eval count=notable_count | eval _ex_refresh=$ex_refresh|s$ | lookup imperva_ioc_dismissed ip AS src OUTPUT dismissed_at | where isnull(dismissed_at) OR last_seen > tonumber(dismissed_at) | eval severity=case(_sev_rank=5,"critical", _sev_rank=4,"high", _sev_rank=3,"medium", _sev_rank=2,"low", _sev_rank=1,"informational", true(),"-") | eval first_detected=strftime(first_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), last_detected=strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | eval rule_name=mvjoin(rule_name, "; "), incident_no=coalesce(mvjoin(incident_no, ", "), "-"), status=coalesce(mvjoin(status, ", "), "-") | eval msg="Detected by: ".rule_name." | Incident: ".incident_no." | Severity: ".severity." | Last detected: ".last_detected

| sort - count | head 50 | vtcheck field=src count_field=count | iplocation src | eval location=trim(if(isnotnull(City) AND City!="", City.", ", "").if(isnotnull(Region) AND Region!="", Region.", ", "").coalesce(nullif(Country,""), "-"))." [VT: ".coalesce(vt_country,"-")."]" | eval asn=if(isnull(vt_asn) OR vt_asn="-", "-", "AS".vt_asn." ".vt_as_owner) | eval vt_score=if(vt_status="ok", vt_malicious."/".vt_engines." malicious, ".vt_suspicious." suspicious", vt_status) | impervapolicycheck field=src | eval suggestion_reason=case(waf_policy_verdict="ALLOWLISTED", "allowed by a WAF policy: ".waf_policies, waf_policy_verdict="BLOCKED_ELSEWHERE", "already blocked by another WAF policy: ".waf_policies, true(), suggestion_reason) | eval suggestion=case(waf_policy_verdict="ALLOWLISTED", "DO_NOT_BLOCK", waf_policy_verdict="BLOCKED_ELSEWHERE" OR waf_policy_verdict="BLOCKED_HERE", "ALREADY_BLOCKED", true(), suggestion) | eval Block=case(suggestion="ALREADY_BLOCKED","✔ Blocked", suggestion="DO_NOT_BLOCK","— Do not block", true(),"⛔ Block") | eval Dismiss="✖ Not block" | eval VirusTotal="🔗 Open" | eval prio=case(suggestion="BLOCK",1, suggestion="REVIEW",2, suggestion="MONITOR",3, suggestion="ALREADY_BLOCKED",4, true(),5) | sort prio - _sev_rank - last_seen | table Block Dismiss src rule_name incident_no severity first_detected last_detected notable_count status suggestion suggestion_reason waf_policies vt_score location asn VirusTotal msg

panel.title: Not block $dis_ip$ - it disappears from the table until it is detected again

search.query: | makeresults | eval Confirm="✖ CONFIRM NOT BLOCK", Cancel="↩ Cancel", ip=$dis_ip|s$, incident_no=$dis_incident|s$, rule_name=$dis_rule|s$, reason=$dis_reason|s$ | table Confirm Cancel ip incident_no rule_name reason
| impervadismiss action=add ip=$dis_exec_ip|s$ reason=$dis_exec_reason|s$ incident_no=$dis_exec_incident|s$ | table _time ip status detail reason incident_no user

panel.title: Block several IPs at once - pick IPs, or pick Incident no. to block all IPs of those incidents

search.query: | sort - last_seen | eval label=src." | ".incident_no." | ".rule_name | table src label

| eval incident=split(incident_no, ", ") | mvexpand incident | where incident!="-" | stats dc(src) AS n values(rule_name) AS rule BY incident | eval label=incident." (".n." IPs) ".mvjoin(rule, "; ") | table incident label

| where like(",".$sel_ips|s$.",", "%,".src.",%") | stats values(src) AS ips values(incident_no) AS incidents values(rule_name) AS rules | eval n=mvcount(ips), Confirm="⛔ CONFIRM BLOCK ".n." IPs", Cancel="✖ Cancel", ips=mvjoin(ips, ","), incidents=mvjoin(incidents, ", "), rules=mvjoin(rules, "; ") | table Confirm Cancel n ips incidents rules

table.title: Confirm: block every IP of the selected incidents

search.query: | eval _inc=split(incident_no, ", ") | mvexpand _inc | where like(",".$sel_inc|s$.",", "%,"._inc.",%") | stats values(src) AS ips values(_inc) AS incidents values(rule_name) AS rules | eval n=mvcount(ips), Confirm="⛔ CONFIRM BLOCK ".n." IPs", Cancel="✖ Cancel", ips=mvjoin(ips, ","), incidents=mvjoin(incidents, ", "), rules=mvjoin(rules, "; ") | table Confirm Cancel n incidents ips rules

| makeresults | impervablock action=block ip=$bulk_exec_ips|s$ dry_run=false incident_no=$bulk_exec_inc|s$ threat_actor=$bulk_actor|s$ comment=$bulk_comment|s$ reason="Bulk block from detected IOCs" | table _time ip site_id status verified_in_waf backend soar_container incident_no threat_actor detail

panel.title: Confirm block of $pending_ip$ on Imperva WAF - fill in the block description, then click ✅ CONFIRM BLOCK

search.query: | makeresults | eval Confirm="✅ CONFIRM BLOCK", Cancel="✖ Cancel", ip=$pending_ip|s$, threat_actor=$pb_actor|s$, incident_no=$pb_incident|s$, comment=$pb_comment|s$, suggestion=$pending_sug|s$, virustotal=$pending_vt|s$, location=$pending_loc|s$, reason=$pending_reason|s$ | table Confirm Cancel ip threat_actor incident_no comment suggestion virustotal location reason

| makeresults | impervablock action=block ip=$exec_ip|s$ dry_run=false reason=$exec_reason|s$ threat_actor=$exec_actor|s$ incident_no=$exec_incident|s$ comment=$exec_comment|s$ | table _time ip site_id status verified_in_waf backend soar_container threat_actor incident_no comment detail user reason
| where src!="-" | stats count AS total_ips values(src) AS ips | eval ips=mvjoin(ips, ",") | table total_ips ips

| makeresults | eval confirmed=$confirm|s$ | impervablock action=$action|s$ ip=$ip_list|s$ dry_run=false reason=$reason|s$ threat_actor=$threat_actor|s$ incident_no=$incident_no|s$ comment=$comment|s$ | table _time ip site_id action status verified_in_waf threat_actor incident_no comment detail user reason

| impervalist | eval _refresh=$waf_refresh|s$ | lookup imperva_block_registry site_id ip OUTPUT status AS reg_status blocked_at blocked_by threat_actor incident_no comment reason source | append [| inputlookup imperva_block_registry where status="blocked" | eval in_waf="no" | rename status AS reg_status | fields site_id ip in_waf reg_status blocked_at blocked_by threat_actor incident_no comment reason source] | stats max(in_waf) AS in_waf values(site_name) AS site_name values(reg_status) AS reg_status max(blocked_at) AS blocked_at values(blocked_by) AS blocked_by values(threat_actor) AS threat_actor values(incident_no) AS incident_no values(comment) AS comment values(reason) AS reason values(source) AS source values(detail) AS detail max(checked_at) AS checked_at BY site_id ip | eventstats max(eval(if(in_waf="error",1,0))) AS site_err max(checked_at) AS last_check BY site_id | where (ip!="-" AND in_waf!="empty") OR in_waf="error" | eval verification=case(in_waf="error", "⚠ Cannot read WAF: ".mvjoin(detail," "), in_waf="yes" AND reg_status="blocked", "✔ Verified on WAF", in_waf="yes", "✔ On WAF (blocked outside Splunk - no description)", site_err=1, "⚠ Unknown (WAF read error)", true(), "✖ NOT on WAF - removed or failed") | eval new=if(isnotnull(blocked_at) AND now()-blocked_at < 3600, "🆕 NEW", "") | eval blocked_time=if(isnotnull(blocked_at), strftime(blocked_at, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "-") | eval last_checked_on_waf=strftime(last_check, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | fillnull value="-" threat_actor incident_no comment blocked_by reason site_name | sort 0 - blocked_at

single.title: Total blocked IPs on WAF now (live)

search.query: | where in_waf="yes" | stats dc(ip) AS total
| where verification="✔ Verified on WAF" | stats count

single.title: Registered as blocked but NOT on WAF

search.query: | where like(verification, "✖%") | stats count
| where new!="" AND in_waf="yes" | stats count
index=_internal source=*imperva_ioc_block.log (status=blocked OR status=unblocked) dry_run=False | eval _refresh=$waf_refresh|s$ | fields _time ip site_id status
| where status="blocked" | stats dc(ip) AS total_blocked_ips
| where status="blocked" | timechart span=1d dc(ip) AS blocked

single.title: Average blocked IPs per day (30 days)

search.query: | where status="blocked" | timechart span=1d dc(ip) AS blocked | stats avg(blocked) AS avg_per_day | eval avg_per_day=round(avg_per_day,1)

panel.title: Daily block / unblock count - last 30 days

search.query: | eval series=if(status="blocked","Blocked IPs","Unblocked IPs") | timechart span=1d dc(ip) BY series | fillnull value=0

panel.title: Daily blocks by Threat actor / Incident - last 30 days

search.query: index=_internal source=*imperva_ioc_block.log status=blocked dry_run=False | eval _refresh=$waf_refresh|s$ | bin _time span=1d | stats dc(ip) AS blocked_ips values(ip) AS ips BY _time threat_actor incident_no | eval day=strftime(_time, "%Y-%m-%d") | sort 0 - _time | table day threat_actor incident_no blocked_ips ips

panel.title: Blocked IPs on Imperva WAF - read LIVE from the WAF policy (auto refresh 5 min + after every block/unblock)

input.label: 🔎 Search blocked list (IP, site, threat actor, incident, comment) - * = all

search.query: | eval _q=lower(replace($waf_q|s$, "[*]", "")) | eval _hay=lower(ip." ".site_id." ".site_name." ".mvjoin(threat_actor," ")." ".mvjoin(incident_no," ")." ".mvjoin(comment," ")." ".mvjoin(blocked_by," ")) | where _q="" OR like(_hay, "%"._q."%") | eval Unblock=if(in_waf="yes", "🔓 Unblock", "-") | eval Events="🔍 Search" | table Unblock Events new blocked_time ip site_id site_name verification threat_actor incident_no comment blocked_by reason last_checked_on_waf

| makeresults | eval Confirm="🔓 CONFIRM UNBLOCK", Cancel="✖ Cancel", ip=$unb_ip|s$, site_id=$unb_site|s$, site_name=$unb_site_name|s$, blocked=$unb_blocked|s$, block_description=$unb_desc|s$, unblock_reason=$unb_reason|s$, incident_no=$unb_incident|s$ | table Confirm Cancel ip site_id site_name blocked block_description unblock_reason incident_no

panel.title: Unblock result: $unb_exec_ip$ (site $unb_exec_site$) - click a row to dismiss

search.query: | makeresults | impervablock action=unblock ip=$unb_exec_ip|s$ site_id=$unb_exec_site|s$ dry_run=false reason=$unb_exec_reason|s$ incident_no=$unb_exec_incident|s$ | table _time ip site_id action status verified_in_waf detail user reason incident_no

panel.title: Dismissed IPs (Not block) - hidden until detected again. Click "↩ Restore" to show it again now

search.query: | impervadismiss | eval _r=$ex_refresh|s$ | eval Restore="↩ Restore", dismissed=if(isnum(dismissed_at), strftime(dismissed_at, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "-") | table Restore ip reason incident_no dismissed_by dismissed
| impervadismiss action=remove ip=$dis_restore|s$ | table _time ip status detail user
index=_internal source=*imperva_ioc_block.log | table _time user action ip site_id status verified_in_waf backend soar_container threat_actor incident_no comment reason detail | sort - _time
